stencil-eye.summary: Three upright stencil plates stacked front to back: a peach almond sclera sheet, a blue iris ring sheet with a lime zigzag cut, and a black pupil disc, on a masking-tape plinth with overspray blocks at the edges.
stencil-eye.pose: stencil stack: the eye as three cut frisket plates standing upright one in front of another, sclera at the back, iris ring in the middle, pupil disc at the front, facing the camera.

frisket-arch.summary: Two thin upright stencil sheets with an almond cut-out, joined by a strip of cream masking tape as the lintel.

cut-stencil-sheet.summary: A thin rectangular sheet on a block foot, pierced by a hard almond or circle cut, one face sprayed in a two-step gradient.

overspray-plume.summary: A fan of stacked soft blocks, narrow and dense at the base and wider and paler upward, like one airbrush pass.

tape-roll.summary: A chunky cream roll of masking tape lying on its side with a dark core hole and a torn tail.

airbrush-lamp.summary: A gold airbrush pen standing on its tail in a block stand, a cyan glowing nozzle cone at the top.

spatter-pad.summary: A flat decal of gouache spatter: white and cyan dots of three sizes scattered over the cell.

things.text: A lifted frisket plate, its masked edge dusted peach to cyan.
